# Bantu Pools

> Bantu Pools is a swimming pool services company in Johannesburg, South Africa. It does weekly pool cleaning and chemical balancing, green-to-clean pool rescues, equipment repairs (pumps, filters, heaters, leak detection) and full pool renovations and resurfacing. 15+ years of experience, 500+ pools serviced, licensed and insured. Free quotes, usually the same day, via WhatsApp.

## Quick facts

- Business type: swimming pool cleaning, repair and renovation contractor
- Based in: Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
- Service area: Johannesburg, Sandton, Randburg, Fourways, Midrand, Roodepoort, Bryanston, Soweto and the greater Johannesburg area
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 07:00 to 17:00; 24/7 emergency call-outs
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +27 83 688 3238 (https://wa.me/27836883238)
- Quotes: free, no call-out fee. Send a photo of the pool on WhatsApp for a same-day price
- Languages: English
- Website: https://www.bantupools.co.za/

## Services

- [Pool cleaning & maintenance](https://www.bantupools.co.za/services.html): weekly visits covering skimming, vacuuming, basket emptying, waterline tile brushing and precise chlorine/pH balancing. Green-to-clean rescues for neglected pools, usually sparkling again within days.
- [Equipment repairs](https://www.bantupools.co.za/services.html): pump diagnostics, filter cleaning and sand replacement, gas and electric heater repair, pressure testing for hidden leaks.
- [Renovations & resurfacing](https://www.bantupools.co.za/services.html): replastering (quartz, pebble, marble plaster), modern glass/ceramic tiling, LED lighting, coping repair.
